Adventure Sixty North Team Payment Information: Full payment (100%) is required at the time of renting any gear.
Cancellation Policy: To receive a full refund, please cancel your gear rental at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled delivery time.
Cancellations made within 24 hours of the delivery time will incur a 15% cancellation fee, resulting in a refund of 85% of the total rental cost.
Cancellations initiated by the renter due to weather reasons are not eligible for a refund.
If we cancel due to weather reasons, you will receive a 100% refund.
